description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Tivit.
Tivit enters the battlefield, creating at least one Treasure token and two Clue and/or Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Clue and/or Treasure tokens, untapping Sol Ring.
Repeat.
